name: Access Roles
description: Access Roles is for anyone who shares a Jellyfin server with family, kids or guests. You make roles, starting from a Kid, Guest or Standard preset, that lock parts of a user's own settings, keep them away from the Dashboard and from other users, and pick which libraries they can open. The server enforces the roles in every app, not just the web client, and keeps library access up to date as libraries come and go. You see a preview of every change before it is saved, with an audit log, snapshots and export to fall back on. You can also turn the library access your users already have into roles in one step.
overview: Give your users roles that lock their settings and pick which libraries they can open

versions.changelog:
- Lock parts of a user's own settings, such as profile or playback.
- Pick which libraries each role can open, and keep every user's
  library access up to date as libraries come and go.
- Keep non-admins away from the Dashboard's data and other users.
- The server enforces the roles in every app, not just the web client.
- Give new users default roles, LDAP and SSO users included.
- Preview every change before it is saved, and keep a log of each one.
- Export, import and restore your setup, or move it to a new server.
- Turn your users' current library access into roles in one step.

- For Jellyfin 12.4 and later: the same plugin as 1.0.3, built for
  Jellyfin 12. Jellyfin 10.11 servers keep 1.0.3.

- First public release.
- Roles for your Jellyfin users: lock parts of their own settings, keep them away from the Dashboard's data and from other users, and choose which libraries they can open.
- The server enforces the roles for every client, not just the web client, and every change is previewed before it is saved.

name: Bookmarks And Clips
description: Bookmarks And Clips lets everyone on your server save moments in movies and episodes, give them a name and jump back to them later. Press Shift+B while you watch, then find your bookmarks on the progress bar, on the video's own page or on the My Bookmarks page. Give a bookmark an end time and it can be cut into a clip, which you can preview, download and manage on My Clips, or keep in a clip library with the movie's artwork. You can also export a whole playlist into one video file, and bring over the bookmarks you made in Jellyfin Enhanced.
overview: Bookmark moments in movies and episodes, name them, and turn them into clips

versions.changelog:
- Bookmark any moment while you watch, with Shift+B or a button,
  and give it a name.
- See your bookmarks on the progress bar, on each video's page and
  on the My Bookmarks page, with search, filters and sorting.
- Step frame by frame to put a bookmark exactly where you want it.
- Turn a bookmark with an end time into a clip you can preview,
  download, rename and remake on the My Clips page.
- Keep clips in a library of their own, with the movie's artwork.
- Export a whole playlist into one video file.
- Bring over the bookmarks you made in Jellyfin Enhanced.
- Back up your bookmarks with export, import and daily snapshots.

- A clip's file is now named with its own name first, then the
  video's title, then the time range: "Bank job - Heat (1995)
  [01.52.10-01.55.00].mp4". A clip without a name stays "Heat (1995)
  [..]". Clips you already have keep their names (they aren't shown
  as "Name changed"); Rename or Rename file gives one the new order.
- Each clip's first frame is now its thumbnail: it is saved beside
  the clip as its poster and thumbnail, and shown on the video's
  Clips row, on My Clips and in a clip library. A clip made again or
  adjusted gets its new first frame; clips you already have get one
  at the next clip artwork pass. If ffmpeg can't take the frame, the
  film's poster is used, as before. A new setting, "Use each clip's
  first frame as its thumbnail" (on by default), turns it off.

- Bookmarks and Clips rows on a video's page, in the same style as
  its Scenes and Special Features rows, right after Scenes. Each
  bookmark is a card showing the frame at that moment, its name and
  time (a scissors when it has a clip); click it to play from there.
  Each of your clips from that video is a card with its own artwork
  or the frame at its start, its name, length and range; click it to
  play it (a clip in a library plays in Jellyfin's player). The ⋮
  menu on a card has every action the old "My bookmarks" list had
  (name, edit, delete, make, cancel, preview, download or delete a
  clip) and My Clips' actions for a clip; "Manage" opens My
  Bookmarks for that video. They work with a mouse, a keyboard, a TV
  remote and on a phone.

- Export a playlist to the clip folder: a playlist's page has Export
  to clips folder. Its videos (films, episodes, clips, any video) are
  joined end to end, in playlist order, into one MP4 named after the
  playlist, beside your clips. Before it starts you see how many videos,
  which are left out and why, the running time, the picture size, and
  about how big it will be and how long it takes (with a warning over 3
  hours or 20 GB). Made with the clip quality settings, one at a time;
  its progress, and a Cancel, are on the My Clips page. The same
  permission as clips.

- Frame by frame in the web player: Back one frame and Forward one
  frame buttons, and the , and . keys (as on YouTube). A step pauses
  the video and shows exactly the frame before or after; hold a key to
  keep stepping. It works when the video is transcoded too, a little
  slower.
- Adjust a bookmark frame by frame: in the player's Bookmarks list,
  Adjust shows the bookmark's start on a small bar over the video. Step
  to the right frame, choose Set start here (or Set end here for a
  range) and Save. Cancel leaves it as it was. A bookmark with a clip
  keeps it, as when its times are edited: make the clip again for the
  new range.

- Clips get their video's artwork: for a clip folder that is a Home
  Videos and Photos library, each clip gets the film's poster and
  backdrop (an episode's series poster and its own image) as image files
  beside it, so the library shows those instead of a frame from the
  clip. Made with the clip, kept with it when it is renamed, and deleted
  with it; the daily maintenance gives clips made before theirs. A new
  setting (Clips), on by default, turns it off.

- For Jellyfin 12.4 and later: the same plugin as 1.2.2, built for
  Jellyfin 12. Jellyfin 10.11 servers keep 1.2.2.

- First public release.
- Each user can bookmark moments in movies and episodes while watching, name them, and find them again on the My Bookmarks page.
- A bookmark with an end time can be cut into a clip file with ffmpeg; the My Clips page lists, previews and downloads your clips.
- Bookmarks made in Jellyfin Enhanced can be imported.

name: Library Maintenance
description: Library Maintenance helps you find the movies you have more than once. It adds a Dashboard page for administrators that lists the duplicates across your libraries, explains why each match was made, shows the space the extra copies take and suggests a copy to keep. You can filter and sort the groups, and compare a movie's copies side by side to decide which to keep. You can also preview moving a movie, episode or music video to another folder, and export and import your settings. Nothing in your libraries is deleted, moved or changed.
overview: Find the movies you have more than once, and preview moving media

versions.changelog:
- Lists the movies your libraries hold more than once.
- Explains each match and suggests a copy to keep.
- Shows how much space the extra copies take.
- Filters and sorts the groups by library, confidence, title and more.
- Compares a movie's copies side by side and marks the best of each
  detail.
- Previews moving a movie, episode or music video to another folder.
- Exports and imports the settings, and previews a change to them.
- Leaves your files alone: nothing is deleted, moved or changed.

- Duplicates: Compare copies on a group's card shows its copies side by
  side, read on request: each file's name and folder, size, container,
  runtime, resolution, video codec, bit depth, dynamic range (SDR, HDR10,
  Dolby Vision...), frame rate and bitrates, its audio tracks (language,
  codec, channels, title, commentary, default) and subtitles (forced,
  default, embedded or external), its special features by kind and by
  where they are (beside the file, in an extras folder, elsewhere), when
  it was added, how many users played it, and whether its file is there.
  The best value of each detail is marked, and what differs. Works on a
  phone and with the TV remote. Still read-only: nothing is deleted,
  merged, moved or written.
- The same as 1.0.5 for Jellyfin 10.11, built for Jellyfin 12.4.

- For Jellyfin 12.4 and later: the same plugin as 1.0.4, built for
  Jellyfin 12. Jellyfin 10.11 servers keep 1.0.4.

- First public release.
- An admin-only page that lists the movies your libraries hold more than once, with the space the extra copies take.
- A preview of moving a movie, an episode or a music video to another folder. The plugin is read-only: it moves, deletes and changes nothing in your libraries.

name: Smart Search And Dynamic Collections
description: Smart Search And Dynamic Collections adds an Advanced Search page for finding movies, shows, episodes and more by title, year, genre, people, ratings, watch state and many other details. You can mix rules in groups, then save a search for yourself or share it with everyone on your server. Each search only finds what the person running it can see. Admins and collection managers can turn a saved search into a dynamic collection that updates itself as your library changes, keeps your own adds and removes, and holds back large removals for review when a drive goes missing.
overview: Search by almost any detail, save and share searches, and build collections that update themselves

versions.changelog:
- An Advanced Search page, in Library tools and in the header.
- Find movies, shows, episodes and more by title, year, genre, people,
  ratings, watch state and many other details.
- Mix rules in groups, and see results as posters or a list.
- Save searches for yourself or share them with others on the server.
- Dynamic collections that follow a saved search and keep themselves
  up to date, with a preview, a history and a note on their page.
- Items you add or remove by hand stay that way, and large removals
  wait for your review when a library looks unhealthy.
- Export, import and daily snapshots of searches and collections.
- Every search only finds what the person running it can see.

- First release for Jellyfin 12.4 and later (versions 2.x; Jellyfin 10.11
  servers keep getting 1.x).
- People in the advanced search: a People rule finds what one or more
  people are credited on, as actors, directors, writers, producers,
  composers or guest stars, or in any role. It matches any, all, none
  or not all of them: "Robert De Niro and Al Pacino as actors", or
  "directed by Ridley Scott or Tony Scott".
- People are picked from suggestions as you type (2 letters or more).
  Only people credited on something you can see are suggested.
- Saved searches and auto-collections can use People rules. A saved
  rule still finds a person after Jellyfin rebuilds its people, by
  their name.

- First public release.
- An Advanced Search page: find movies, shows, episodes, music videos and collections by rules over title, year, library, genres, ratings, watch state and more, and save searches, private or shared.
- Auto-collections: Jellyfin collections that the plugin keeps equal to a saved search's results.
- Every search only shows what the signed-in user may see.

name: Tag Cloud
description: Tag Cloud turns your library's tags, genres, actors, directors, writers and studios into a word cloud, with the most common words drawn biggest. Click any word to see the movies and shows behind it, hold it down to see them as a cloud of their own, or right-click a few words to narrow the cloud down. You can change how the cloud looks, show it full screen, and save the ones you like to rename, copy or share with everyone on your server. Each person's cloud counts just the titles they can see.
overview: Shows your library's tags, genres, people and studios as a word cloud you can click through

versions.changelog:
- A Tag Cloud page that turns your tags, genres, people and studios
  into a word cloud, with the most common words drawn biggest.
- Click a word to see its movies and shows, then filter and sort them.
- Hold a word down to see its titles as a cloud of their own.
- Right-click words to narrow the cloud to the titles they share.
- Change the layout, shape, font, colours and backdrop to your taste.
- Save clouds to rename, copy or share, or show one full screen.
- Each person's counts cover just the titles they can see.
- Daily backups of the saved clouds, and a recount when you need it.

- A word's titles can be filtered by name (or original title,
  ignoring case and accents), sorted by name, release date, date
  added or rating either way round, limited to a minimum resolution
  (movies) or to what you haven't watched, with Reset and a count of
  how many are left. The choices are kept per user on each device.
- Resting the mouse on an actor, director or writer shows their
  photo and how many titles credit them; in a word's held-down
  cloud, resting on a title shows its poster.

- A word's titles now show as poster cards, like a library or a
  collection, each opening the title's page.
- With Mix sizes turned up, long words no longer stick out to the
  side of the cloud: a word that comes late goes where it keeps to
  the cloud's shape.

- For Jellyfin 12.4 and later: the same plugin as 1.0.1, built for
  Jellyfin 12. Jellyfin 10.11 servers keep 1.0.1.

- First public release.
- A Tag Cloud page that shows the tags, genres, actors, directors, writers or studios of your movies and shows as a word cloud; click a word to see its titles.
- Saved clouds, private or shared, and a full-screen view. Counts only cover what the viewer may see.

name: User Ratings And Reviews
description: User Ratings And Reviews lets the people on your server rate movies, shows, episodes, albums, books and more from half a star to five stars, and write a review if they like. Everyone sees each other's ratings and reviews on the titles they can open, with the members' average, a histogram and spoilers kept blurred. As an admin you choose who may rate and what can be rated, and remove reviews that don't belong, with a log of each removal. You can back up, restore and move every rating with export, import and daily snapshots, and ratings stay with their titles when files move. If you used Jellyfin Enhanced's reviews, you can bring them over, or send them back.
overview: Lets everyone on your server rate and review what they watch, from half a star to five stars

versions.changelog:
- Rate movies, shows, episodes, albums, books and more from half a
  star to five stars, and add a review if you like.
- See everyone's ratings and reviews on a title, in the order you
  like, with the members' average next to its other scores.
- Mark a review as a spoiler so it stays blurred until someone opens
  it.
- Admins pick who can rate and what, and remove reviews that don't
  belong, with a log of each removal.
- Back up, restore or move every rating with export, import and
  daily snapshots.
- Ratings stay with their titles when files are renamed or moved,
  and admins can relink or purge the ones left behind.
- Bring reviews over from Jellyfin Enhanced, or send them back.

- For Jellyfin 12.4 and later: the same plugin as 1.0.2, built for
  Jellyfin 12. Jellyfin 10.11 servers keep 1.0.2.

- First public release.
- Members rate movies, shows, episodes and more from half a star to five stars and write reviews, shared with every member of the server.
- Admins choose who may rate, moderate reviews, and export, import and restore the ratings. Jellyfin Enhanced's reviews can be imported and exported back.
